title: Summary and review exercise
competency: Bring together the ideas of Unit 2.

keywords.def: Anything that has mass and occupies space.
The mixing and spreading out of a substance because its particles move.
A single kind of matter that cannot be separated by physical means.
A physical combination of two or more pure substances.
A change in appearance, not composition.

en.text: Matter has mass and occupies space. It is made of tiny moving particles and exists as solid, liquid or gas. States change by adding or removing energy. Matter is pure (elements and compounds) or a mixture (homogeneous or heterogeneous). Changes are physical or chemical. Mixtures are separated by physical methods.

screens.title: Unit summary
paras: Matter has mass and occupies space. It exists as solid, liquid or gas.
Matter is made of tiny particles that are always moving.
Diffusion is spreading out because particles move.
States change when energy is added or removed.
table: Cannot be broken down by ordinary chemical means
Elements chemically combined in a definite proportion by mass

screens.title: Changes and separation
paras: A physical change alters appearance, not composition.
A chemical change alters the chemical composition.
Mixtures are separated by physical methods that use differences in physical properties.
Methods: by hand, sieving, filtration, evaporation, magnetic separation, decantation, distillation.

items.text: Depending upon the temperature, water can exist in solid, liquid or gas states.

items.text: Which of the following decreases during the changes solid → liquid → gas?
items.why: Particles become less orderly; energy, speed and distance increase.

items.ask: When rain falls, it is because water vapour in the clouds is condensing into liquid ___.
items.why: Condensation turns vapour into liquid water.

items.ask: The separation technique that heats a solution until the liquid becomes a gas, leaving a solid, is ___.
items.clue: Think of getting salt from salt water.
